% pgfplots oracle fixture (hand-written): legend outside the axis with a
% title, \legend with an empty entry, and a forget plot.
\begin{tikzpicture}
\begin{axis}[legend pos=outer north east, title=Outer legend, xlabel=$x$, ylabel=$y$]
\addplot coordinates {(0,0) (1,1) (2,1.5)};
\addplot+[forget plot, only marks] coordinates {(0.5,0.5) (1.5,1.2)};
\addplot coordinates {(0,1) (1,0.5) (2,0)};
\addplot coordinates {(0,2) (1,2.2) (2,2.4)};
\legend{rising,,constant}
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
